title: SEO Specialist | Content Driven
description:
## The role in one line



You lead SEO for a small portfolio of clients and own what we deliver to them: strategy, on-page, content and links. You set the direction for each campaign and ensure the work that goes out is genuinely good.



## We are a small agency, and that is the point



We are small on purpose and growing steadily, so read the responsibilities below in that light. You would lead fewer than 10 active campaigns, and they would be small in scope, not sprawling enterprise accounts. We cap how much any one person carries: before the work piles up, we bring in more people to support the other parts of a campaign. You are also free to bring in copywriters and link-building contractors, and to manage them.



So, while the list below may look broad, you are not doing all of it alone or at scale. You lead the campaigns, set the standard, and pull in support where it helps. We also have someone who handles technical SEO, so that is not on your plate day-to-day.



## Who you would be working for



We are part of Lakewood media, a UK agency going since 2013.



We care about more than rankings. The wider mission is to do excellent digital work for purpose-driven businesses while giving something back, including a commitment to plant 1,000 trees by 2027 and a focus on the communities we work in across the UK, the Philippines and South Africa. We are aiming to become one of the top premium UK digital agencies, and we want the people who help get us there to grow with us.



## How we work, and why you would want to



We are a small, distributed team, and we are genuinely flexible.



- Work the hours that suit you. Your working day is largely yours to shape.

- Your location does not matter to us. Work from wherever you are.

- The only fixed ask is that you are available for the handful of meetings we schedule.

- We judge the work by its outputs, not by hours logged.

- You would be part of a small team where your opinion, expertise and time are genuinely valued.



## What makes this role different



Most of our current work sits inside one niche: high-end adult brands, specifically escort agencies. This is under our agency HauteLab. You will start there, across our full client roster, and learn that world by working in it.



Within roughly the next 6-12 months, you will also take on clients for our sister brand, Peak Narrative, which operates in very different sectors: education, the environment, and outdoor lifestyle. The delivery model is the same. The niches are not.



That is why we care far more about strong, current SEO fundamentals than about niche experience. Good SEO works in any niche. We can quickly hand you the context for a sector, we cannot teach sound judgment as quickly. If you understand why something ranks, you will be effective whether the page is about an escort agency or a private school.



## What you will own



- Lead every SEO campaign in your portfolio: set the strategy, priorities and roadmap, and keep each one moving

- Own the deliverables. You build the monthly deliverable reports and bring them to Adam, who stays the client's primary point of contact and runs the live monthly reviews

- Plan content strategy for each client, oversee content creation (your own and your writers'), and edit to a high standard

- Run link building at the small scale these clients need, bringing in and managing link contractors to help

- Hire and manage copywriters and freelancers where it helps: brief them, review their work, keep them on time and on standard

- Keep the client workbooks accurate and delivery on cadence



## The SEO expertise we need



We want an all-out SEO expert, someone whose judgment we can trust on any campaign. Specifically, deep command of:



- On-page SEO, inside out: titles, headings, internal linking, structured data and content quality, all matched to user intent rather than a word count.

- Content strategy: planning topic clusters and the pieces that actually move rankings, not filler or generic AI nonsense. **We are looking for someone with ‘outside the box’ thinking that can work with clients to build unique content angles.**

- Trust and E-E-A-T as a site-wide signal: about pages, author and trust signals, and non-commodity content that earns its place.

- Current SEO strategy: people-first content as the baseline (the Helpful Content System is now part of core ranking), and a clear-eyed view of AI search. AI Overviews and AI Mode run on the same systems as classic search, so doing real SEO covers both. We do not chase "AEO" or "GEO" gimmicks.

- The value of links and how to build them at small scale: quality over quantity, a real grasp of anchor distribution, velocity and source diversity, and the judgment to win a few strong links rather than many weak ones.

    - Understanding how to us AI tools to during this process is critical. For example using Claude Code to build tailored targets for outreach and push them into a cold outreach campaign on Smartlead.



## Tools and data



- SEO and analytics: strong working mastery of Ahrefs, Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.

- Site audits: you do not have to be our deep technical person, we have someone who handles technical SEO. But when an Ahrefs or Screaming Frog audit flags issues, you need to read it, know which on-page problems matter, and either fix them yourself or direct how they should be fixed.

- AI as a force multiplier: a real part of how we work, covered in its own section below. Deep knowledge of Claude using Cowork, Code and skills.

- Our stack: Asana (project management), Notion (knowledge base), Missive 
 and comms), Pipedrive (sales), Google Workspace and WordPress for sites we build and manage.



## Working with AI (a big part of how we operate)



We lean on AI to keep quality high and delivery efficient, so using it well genuinely matters here. We do test for it, because it is part of the job, not a bolt-on.



We are not looking for someone who pastes a prompt into Claude and copies the answer back out. We want someone who builds AI into the work to lift the quality and the speed of the end result. In practice that means:



- Using Claude on real, multi-step tasks, not one-off questions

- Building repeatable workflows with connectors and skills. For example: pull a Screaming Frog crawl or a GSC via Composio connector, break it down, cross-reference it against Ahrefs, then turn it into a clear, prioritised report a client can read in plain English

- Being able to maintain and use more advanced setups, not just chat. Cowork and Code for long complex tasks. Building skills and updating existing to make processes and workflows more efficient.

- Knowing the line between augmenting your judgment and outsourcing it. AI improves the output; it does not produce the deliverable unsupervised



Done well, this is how one person handles more clients without the quality dropping. It is central to how we operate.



## Attention to detail and organisation (non-negotiable)



You will hold many moving parts across several clients at once: content stages, link logs, reporting deadlines, vendor spend and workbook hygiene. Small errors compound fast across a portfolio. We need someone genuinely meticulous and well organised, who keeps trackers accurate, follows a process and does not let things slip. This is a hard requirement, and the assessment is built to surface whether you have it.



## What a typical week looks like



This is built from the real work the role carries today, not a generic list.



**Content**



- Plan the month's content for each client and brief the freelance writers (when needed)

- Write and edit blog posts, landing pages, city and category pages, and client profile pages

- Review writers' drafts against the brief and our human-first standard before anything goes live



**Links**



- Own each client's link plan, build links at the small scale they need, and use contractors to help with outreach and placements

- Vet and rate links from vendors, find and buy relevant expired domains, and log every live link in the workbook



**Technical and analysis**



- Review Ahrefs and Screaming Frog site audits and turn the findings into a prioritised on-page action list (our technical specialist handles the heavy technical fixes)

- Check Search Console for discovered-but-not-indexed content and track stage keywords in Ahrefs

- Run competitor and link-gap analysis, on-page audits and trust or about-page builds



**Reporting and admin**



- Produce end-of-month deliverables summaries per client and set up the next month's content stages

- Keep workbooks clean (stage IDs, content planner, live links), document decisions in the client wiki, and stay on top of client



## Being upfront about the niche



We specialise in high-end adult brands, specifically escort agencies. We are completely transparent about this from the start, because we know it is not for everyone.



The work itself is standard SEO and content delivery. If you are not comfortable working in this sector, this is not the right role, and that is fine. We would rather you know now than later.



## Who this is for



- A genuine SEO expert who can lead campaigns and own delivery without hand-holding

- Deep on content, on-page, E-E-A-T and links (technical depth is a bonus, not a must, we have that covered)

- Genuinely fluent with AI as a working tool, not a novelty

- Meticulous, organised and reliable on deadlines

- Comfortable in the adult niche, able to flex into other sectors, and keen to grow with us long term



## Who it is not for



- Specialists who only do one slice of SEO and cannot lead a whole campaign

- Anyone who needs a fixed playbook and struggles when the niche changes

- "AI users" whose skill stops at pasting prompts

- Anyone who needs AI to understand the work they are doing.



## Where this role can go



This is not a seat to fill and forget. We are growing, and we want the person we bring in now to grow with us and become a key part of the agency. As we add clients, you would lead a bigger share of delivery and bring people in under you rather than just carry more yourself.



The rate is a starting point, and we expect it to rise as you take on more and as we grow. If you want somewhere to do excellent work and build something over the next few years, this is it.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
description:
Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Ecommerce Fulfillment & Shipping Operations Coordinator
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're a premium direct-to-consumer apparel brand selling mainly to US customers, with manufacturing in Asia and warehouses in the US. We're hiring a hands-on Fulfillment & Shipping Operations Coordinator to run the daily operations that get orders shipped correctly, keep our inventory accurate, and keep our shipping costs in check.



YOUR THREE PRIORITIES (what you'll be measured on)

1. Inventory accuracy. Make sure we never lose stock; when stock is lost, file and recover the claim; and keep inventory counts accurate and matched across every system.

2. Getting orders to customers. Fast fulfillment from the 
nt an order is placed, fast delivery from the 
nt it ships, and quick resolution of any issue along the way.

3. Costs. Verify every shipping, warehouse, and returns charge is accurate, and continuously find ways to reduce those costs.



HOW THE ROLE WORKS

The core of this job is daily: making sure orders flow to the right warehouse, handling the exceptions our automation can't, and working our issue/tracking boards (shipping issues, unfulfilled orders, late deliveries) through to resolution every business day. Around that sits a lighter set of monthly tasks (inbound receiving, inventory checks, a few reports, and carrier-invoice verification) — much of which is already automated, so the job is to run and verify those, not build them by hand.



You'll work across our ecommerce platform, order-management and warehouse systems, and a project/issue-tracking tool, coordinate with the team over chat, and follow written SOPs. Hours are standard Philippine business hours (about 9am–6pm PHT); no night shift. Working time is tracked with a time-tracking tool.



This is NOT entry-level. You should have run ecommerce fulfillment before, be comfortable learning and working across multiple systems, stay organized under a daily queue, and communicate clearly and promptly. If you go quiet when things get hard, this isn't for you. If you take ownership and keep things moving without being chased, you'll do well here.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Daily — order fulfillment (priority 2):

- Oversee the daily order flow. Most orders route to the right warehouse automatically; you make sure the daily outbound completes cleanly and handle the exceptions.

- Process manual-override cases: split orders across two warehouses, international orders (purchase/register the shipping label, attach the commercial invoice), and reshipments.

- Reconcile edited/held orders between the store and the warehouse system.



Daily — shipping-issue & delivery resolution (priority 2):

- Own the issue boards end to end: log each issue, classify it, respond to the customer within 24 hours, follow up with the warehouse/carrier on a set cadence, resolve it (reship/refund/claim), and close it out.

- Clear open/unfulfilled orders flagged by automation within SLA.

- Track late or non-moving shipments and drive resolution with the warehouses and carriers.



Inventory accuracy (priority 1):

- Receive inbound shipments using documentation from Procurement; build the inbound records, reconcile against the packing list, and log any shortages/damage.

- Run the monthly inventory checks (store-vs-warehouse, plus an internal check) and fix discrepancies so stock matches across systems.

- When a warehouse loses or mishandles stock, file the claim and follow it through to recovery.

- Produce the monthly inventory/inbound/outbound/delivery reports — run them, sanity-check the output, and fix anything that looks off.



Costs (priority 3):

- Verify freight, storage, and returns invoices against rate cards using our in-house tool; flag and recover overcharges.

- Continuously look for ways to lower shipping and fulfillment costs (e.g., right-sizing packaging, improving routing, catching recurring billing errors).



REQUIREMENTS

- 3–5 years' hands-on ecommerce fulfillment / shipping / order operations (running the systems, not physical warehouse work).

- Strong experience with a major ecommerce platform (multi-location orders and inventory).

- Experience with order-management/ERP software and third-party warehouse (3PL) systems.

- Experience running an issue/ticket board to a daily SLA.

- Strong spreadsheet skills; comfortable with AI-assisted reporting (a plus).

- Able to audit carrier invoices against rate cards and spot overcharges.

- Excellent written English and fast, reliable communication.

- High attention to detail; dependable during PH business hours; comfortable logging time via a time-tracker; self-manages from written SOPs.



Nice to have: experience with returns and help-desk platforms; apparel/fashion ecommerce; US shipping & customs (DDP/DDU).



HOW TO APPLY (please follow exactly — applications that skip these will not be reviewed)

1. Start your reply with the word XPRESS so I know you read the full post.

2. A short paragraph on your most relevant fulfillment/operations role: which platforms you used and what you personally owned.

3. Scenario A: An order shipped from our warehouse three days ago, but the tracking hasn't moved since. Walk me through how you'd resolve it — what you'd check, who you'd contact, and on what cadence.

4. Scenario B: An order has two items, and each needs to ship from a different warehouse. How would you handle splitting and processing it?

5. What ecommerce platform, order-management/warehouse systems, and issue-tracking tools have you used directly, and for how long?

6. How comfortable are you using AI tools to run or check reports? Give an example if you have one.

7. Your typical working hours in Philippine time, and the longest you've stayed in one fulfillment/operations role.

title: Graphic Designer

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Graphic Designer to join our fashion textile brand full-time.



This is not a basic graphic design role. We are looking for someone with a strong visual eye, excellent taste, and a deep understanding of fashion, ecommerce, branding, and customer psychology.



Our brand sells fashion fabrics and textiles, so the visuals must feel elevated, stylish, modern, feminine, fashion-oriented, and commercially effective. Our product is directed to a high profile customer. We need someone who can create graphics that do not just look nice, but also help sell to this kind of person.



Main Responsibilities



You will help create visual assets for different platforms, including:

* Promotional graphics for product launches, sales, and campaigns

* Meta ad creatives

* Google ad creatives

*
 marketing graphics and campaign visuals

, Pinterest, etc.

* Templates for recurring
 campaigns, ads, and social media posts

* Simple video edits or animated graphics when needed

* Creative assets for branding, storytelling, and product education

* Organizing design files, creative assets, and marketing folders

* Supporting the marketing team with visual direction and creative ideas



We are looking for someone who:



* Has a very strong sense of style, taste, and aesthetics

* Understands fashion, beauty, ecommerce, branding, and modern visual trends

* Can create clean, elevated, feminine, and fashion-oriented designs

* Understands how ads work and how to design visuals that convert

* Has a good understanding of customer psychology and what makes people stop, click, and buy

* Can create high-converting creatives for ads,
, website, and social media

* Has experience designing for ecommerce brands

* Can create visuals that feel premium, not basic or generic

* Has experience working with AI-generated images or AI creative tools

* Can generate or improve realistic AI images when needed

* Can combine AI visuals, product images, typography, graphics, and layout in a polished way

* Can follow brand direction but also bring strong creative ideas

* Can create reusable templates for ads,
s, website banners, and social media

* Communicates clearly and can take feedback professionally

* Is organized, reliable, and detail-oriented

* Is flexible and willing to support different creative and marketing tasks when needed



Tools



You may use any tools you prefer, as long as the final result is strong.



Preferred tools may include:



* Photoshop

* Illustrator

* Canva

* Figma

* CapCut

* AI image generation tools

* AI photo editing tools

*
 design tools

* Other design or editing platforms



We do not care which tool you use. We care about the quality of the final result.



Important



This role is for someone who can think creatively and strategically. A flexible person.



We do not need someone who only knows how to place text on an image. We need someone who understands visual storytelling, fashion aesthetics, ecommerce, customer behavior, and how to create graphics that make a brand look stronger.



Our goal is to elevate the entire visual direction of the brand. We are going through a rebrand, and we need someone who can help us create better, more stylish, more polished, and more high-converting creatives than what we currently have.



The right person should be able to look at a fabric or product and understand how to make it visually desirable.



This Role May Include



Some days may be focused mostly on graphic design. Other days may include helping with AI image generation, creating ad concepts, building
 graphics, organizing creative assets, supporting social media visuals, or preparing campaign materials.



This is not a role for someone who only wants to do one narrow type of design. We need a creative person who can support different parts of the marketing process.



To Apply



Please send:



* Your portfolio or examples of your graphic design work

* Examples of fashion, beauty, ecommerce, ad creatives,
 graphics, or social media designs if you have them

* Examples of AI-generated or AI-enhanced visuals if you have them

* A short message explaining why you think you are a good fit

This is a full-time position with high growth potential.

title: Amazon Catalog manager
description:

-Account Management: Oversee day-to-day operations of our Amazon account, ensuring all listings, content, and storefronts are up-to-date, compliant, and optimized for performance.

Requirements:

-2+ years of experience in Amazon SEO and listing optimization.

-Experience with Helium 10 or similar tools for keyword research.

-Familiarity with Amazon’s ranking algorithm and SEO best practices.

-Knowledge of Amazon’s listing requirements, guidelines, and optimization tactics.

-Proficient in SEO tools, AI content tools, and Excel.

-Strong attention to detail and excellent English communication skills.



Why Work with Us?:

title: Patient Care Coordinator (Medical VA)
description:
About us

OptiME Health is a women's telehealth practice focused on metabolic health, hormones, and longevity (GLP-1 therapy, lab-based protocols, coaching, and nutrition). We are small, mission-driven, and growing. This is a founding-team role with room to grow as we scale.

The role

We're hiring talent that can do two things: build out our Practice Better platform from the ground up, then run the day-to-day patient experience on top of it. You are the operational backbone:  first the architect, then the engine.

This is a care coordination and systems role, not a sales role. You're not closing deals or giving medical advice, you're building and running the infrastructure that keeps the practice organized and patients feeling taken care of.



Phase 1  Build out Practice Better (first 14 days)



Configure our Practice Better instance end to end: patient portal, programs, packages, and provider calendar

Build intake forms, questionnaires, and consent forms inside the platform (we provide the clinical and legal content, you build them and wire them into the patient flow)

Set up automated workflows: onboarding sequences, appointment reminders, follow-up triggers, and program milestones

Configure analytics and reporting: patient progress tracking, program completion, retention, and the dashboards we need to run the business

Build document and message templates and a clean, repeatable patient journey



Ongoing: Run patient operations

Manage day-to-day in Practice Better: onboarding, scheduling, reminders, and message triage

Set up and manage patient accounts in Fullscript (supplement dispensary) and process/track orders

Coordinate lab logistics in Rupa Health: prep and route orders for provider sign-off, track results, flag completed panels (you do not order labs or prescribe, that stays with the provider)

Respond to non-clinical patient messages with warmth and professionalism; escalate anything clinical to the provider

Run care-side follow-up: post-visit check-ins, no-show and reschedule outreach, and milestone nudges

Keep patient records accurate and up to date; maintain the analytics and reporting you built

Light documentation and reporting



Who you are

Has built out and configured Practice Better, not just used it: forms, programs, automated workflows, and reporting. This is the single most important qualification. (Deep experience configuring a comparable platform, Healthie, SimplePractice, Jane plus willingness to master Practice Better can substitute.) Experience with Fullscript and/or Rupa Health is a strong plus.

Experience as a healthcare/medical VA or in a medical admin/patient coordination role

Excellent written English with a warm, calm, professional patient-facing tone

Comfortable with patient privacy: familiar with HIPAA, and willing to complete HIPAA training and sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) before accessing any patient data

Extremely organized, detail-oriented, and proactive. You catch things before they fall through the cracks

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, private workspace

Able to maintain strict confidentiality



Need:

Background in weight management / GLP-1, women's health or functional/longevity medicine

Experience supporting a solo provider or small telehealth practice



Why this role:

You'll be the first dedicated operations hire in a practice that's scaling. The right person grows with us into a lead patient-experience role.

Role Overview

This role requires a strong attention to detail, excellent organisational skills, confidence working with data, confidence working with bespoke systems supported by training, and the ability to follow structured processes accurately.

Essential

• Ability to follow complex processes consistently.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable working with multiple stakeholders across different departments.

• Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

• Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.



Desirable

• Previous experience in planning, scheduling, workforce management, or administration.

• Experience using planning or scheduling software systems.

• Experience working within facilities management, field service, logistics, or operational support environments.

• Experience producing reports and analysing operational data.



What Success Looks Like

• Planning data is maintained accurately and on time.

• Field team schedules are effectively managed and communicated.

• Operational inboxes and administration tasks are completed within agreed service levels.

• System usage and adoption are actively monitored and improved.

At SBFM, you'll become part of a growing international team that plays a vital role in supporting our UK operations. You'll gain exposure to multiple business functions, work with innovative technology, and have opportunities to develop new skills within a fast-paced and supportive environment.

title: Phone Sales & Customer Onboarding Specialist - TimeForTutoring
description:
Time for Tutoring is a Sydney-based tutoring agency that connects Muslim families with qualified tutors. Our brand is built around and trusted by the Muslim community. The vast majority of our customers are Muslim families, and cultural understanding is at the heart of how we operate.

We are looking for someone to handle inbound enquiries, onboard new customers, and maintain ongoing relationships with families over the phone as we scale. We are a business that works 7 days a week and customer outreach is also completed on weekends.



What you'll be doing:



Speaking with warm leads who have already expressed interest in our service and guiding them through to becoming a customer

Calling parents first to gather key information so our team can match them with the right tutor

Explaining our service and pricing clearly and confidently

Handling objections with skill and composure. Parents will push back on price, ask hard questions, and need convincing. Your ability to handle this naturally and without being pushy is one of the most important parts of this role

Being the main point of contact for families after onboarding, maintaining the relationship, checking in, and resolving any concerns that come up

Following up with leads who have not yet committed

Light admin to keep things organised



Who we're looking for:



Excellent spoken English. This is a phone-heavy role with Australian customers and how you come across on a call is everything

A genuine understanding of Islamic culture, Muslim family life, and Muslim values. You do not just know about it, you get it

Warm, confident, and natural on the phone

Proven ability to handle objections and close without being pushy

Someone who builds trust easily and can maintain long term relationships with families

Previous sales, customer service, or phone-based experience required

A requirement of the role is to have a flexible availability as call volume varies day to day. A responsive and reachable individual is needed for this role. The nature of the role involves frequent communications with the team at various times within reason.



This role is not the right fit if you are not familiar with Muslim culture and the expectations of Muslim families.

To apply you must include:



A 60-second voice recording where you introduce yourself and then respond to this scenario: "A parent calls and asks if we can guarantee results. What do you say?"

A brief description of any phone-based or sales experience you have

Answer this question: How familiar are you with Islamic culture and Muslim communities, and where does that familiarity come from?



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. Please do not read an ai scripted response. We appreciate genuine human responses.



This is a part-time role with flexible hours. Pay is a base rate of $5 to $10 AUD per hour plus commission per successful onboarding. The more you convert, the more you earn. There is real room to grow with the business as we scale.

If you have read this job listing in full, write the word SYDNEY at the very top of your application.

E — Excel

 )

description:
About the role

We're a US-based direct-to-consumer skincare brand running paid social at scale, and our growth lives and dies by creative. We're looking for a senior video editor who thinks like a performance marketer and is on top of the latest AI developments.

Beside our team of editors, you will help in the editing pipeline for our Meta ad creative: UGC, VSLs, native-style ads, and rapid hook/variation testing. You'll turn raw footage, AI-generated avatars, and scripts into ads that ship fast and perform, then iterate on the winners. Moreover, you are an expert in AI UGC and animations.



This is a high-volume, high-velocity seat. If you love a tight feedback loop and seeing your work tied directly to results, you'll thrive here. If you need a week to deliver one polished edit, this isn't the role.

What you'll do



Edit and ship Meta ad creative at volume: UGC, VSLs, talking-head, and native formats

Produce multiple hook and angle variations of winning concepts for systematic testing

Cut for the platform: vertical 9:16, burned-in captions, fast pacing, strong first 3 seconds, mobile-first

Work fluently with AI tools: AI avatars and lip-sync (HeyGen, Higgsfield, Kling), AI voice (ElevenLabs), and AI-assisted editing/upscaling/footage workflows



Source and assemble B-roll, motion graphics, text overlays, and product shots into clean, native-feeling ads

Maintain visual variation across a batch so ads read as distinct (avoiding duplicate-detection issues on Meta)

Turn briefs and scripts into finished ads with minimal hand-holding — and flag when something won't work before it's built

Keep an organized, well-named file and asset system so winners can be quickly re-cut and scaled

What we're looking for



3+ years editing short-form video, with real experience editing for Meta /
 & Instagram paid ads (not just organic or YouTube)



A portfolio of direct-response ad creative, show us ads that were built to sell, ideally with performance context

Fluent English, both written and spoken. You'll work from English scripts, write English captions, and communicate clearly with the team daily



Genuinely current with AI video tools. you experiment with new ones the week they drop, not the year after

Fast turnarounds without babysitting. You manage your own queue, hit deadlines, and communicate proactively

Proactive and opinionated. You bring hook ideas, spot what's working in the data, and suggest the next test , you don't wait to be told



Nice to have

Experience editing for another skincare, beauty, or health/wellness brand — bonus if it was DTC / performance-driven

Understanding of direct-response copy and ad structure (hooks, leads, CTAs)

Basic motion graphics / thumbnail / static design

Familiarity with ad testing frameworks and reading basic ad metrics (CTR, hook rate, ROAS)



Why you'll like it here

Your work is directly tied to results — you'll see what wins and double down on it

Real creative ownership and room to test your own ideas

A team that ships fast and values initiative over process

Performance bonuses on top of base for editors whose creative hit the KPIs (NO UPPER LIMIT ON BONUS!)

Location: Fully remote / global · Type: Full-time · Pay: $7–12 USD/hour (depending on experience) + performance bonuses

title: Short-Form Video Editor – High Volume, Fixed Monthly Pay
description:
You get stable monthly income, a clear repeatable process, and a long-term role on a fast-growing content brand.



We are looking for a reliable, fast video editor to join the content team of a German Instagram and TikTok creator in the business niche. The account has 11,000+ followers and is growing fast. We are scaling content volume now ahead of a major product launch later this year.





What the job looks like



You edit short-form vertical videos (45-90 seconds) for Instagram Reels and TikTok. The format is consistent and repeatable: the creator speaks to camera, you remove the background in CapCut, drop in AI-generated images behind him, and sync them to his talking points.



Every video follows the same template. Once you learn it, editing is fast. A good editor will finish 5-10 clips per hour.



Expected output is around 180 clips per month – roughly 1 new Reel and 5 recycled Test-Reels per day.



This is fully async work. You receive footage and assets in Google Drive, edit, and upload exports back. No daily calls, no time zone pressure.





What you earn



€200/month fixed, paid reliably every month.



At 5-10 clips per hour, this works out to roughly €5-11 per hour of actual editing time. The faster and more consistent you are, the better your effective hourly rate.





What you need



CapCut desktop – you already use it or can learn it fast.

Google Chrome – we use one extension for image generation, easy setup, we walk you through it.

Reliable internet and a computer that handles CapCut without issues.

You can follow a written workflow in English and meet daily deadlines.



You do not need to speak German. The footage is in German but we provide everything you need to navigate it without language skills.





What this role can become



This creator is actively building toward a product launch and long-term growth. If you deliver quality work and grow with us, there is room for more volume, more responsibility, and better pay. You will also be able to use this project as a portfolio reference once we hit major milestones.



We are not looking for someone to try this for a few weeks. We want someone who is in it for the long run.





To apply



Send a short message with 2-3 examples of short-form Reels or TikTok videos you have edited, your typical turnaround time from raw footage to finished export, and confirmation that you have CapCut desktop. That is all we need to get started.

Manually build and manage local citations and business directory listings across Canadian and North American platforms — the kind of work a tool like BrightLocal automates, done by hand for accuracy and full control

Set up new accounts and complete listings from scratch where needed, keeping NAP (Name, Address, Phone) data consistent across every directory

Work from a provided master list of target directories for manual entry, and proactively flag additional niche- or region-relevant directories worth adding

Keep listings current over time — updating details, removing duplicates, and verifying entries



AEO, GEO & LLM citation responsibilities



Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): Optimize content to be selected as the direct answer in Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Bing Copilot, Perplexity, voice assistants, and featured snippets

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Ensure our brands, products, and content are accurately represented and cited in outputs from generative AI models including ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini

Audit how — and whether — our brands are cited in LLM outputs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and track citation frequency, accuracy, and sentiment over time

Earn mentions and citations on the sources AI answer engines index most heavily — authoritative publications, industry wikis, Reddit, Quora, and reputable government/educational domains



Note: many of these placements are "no-follow" and won't pass traditional link equity. For AEO/GEO that's expected — the goal is AI citation and entity strength, not PageRank. We want someone who understands that distinction.





Structure content for extraction: lead with a direct 40–60 word answer block, use FAQ schema, speakable schema, and clear entity definitions, and write in an objective, declarative voice (AI engines down-weight "we think / in our opinion" hedging)

Keep content fresh and specific — recency and concrete statistics are heavily weighted, especially by Perplexity, which refreshes near-daily and cites 4–8 sources per answer

Make sure AI crawlers can actually read the page: critical text rendered server-side (not injected by client-side JavaScript), and the right crawler access configured (e.g. OAI-SearchBot for ChatGPT search eligibility, distinct from GPTBot training access)

Develop and execute digital PR strategies aimed at earning mentions on high-E-E-A-T domains that serve as training and retrieval sources for AI models

Strengthen entity recognition across AI systems by optimizing Knowledge Panels, Wikidata entries, and third-party review platforms (G2, Trustpilot, Clutch)





How we work — our standards (non-negotiables)

Link building in 2026 is about earning citations and trust, not gaming volume. We expect you to:



Earn, don't manipulate. No PBNs, link farms, paid link networks, comment spam, or scaled/automated link schemes. Google's spam updates penalize these, and one bad shortcut can damage a client account we've spent months building.

Manually vet every target. Real editorial standards, real organic traffic, real topical relevance — not just a metric in a tool.

Disclose paid placements with rel="sponsored" where applicable.

Build relationships, not one-offs. Repeat publisher relationships beat cold-blasting templates that editors delete on sight.

Honour the human edit pass. Any AI-assisted outreach or content draft gets a human voice + accuracy review before it goes out. Drafts are never sent or published raw.



How we measure success

This role is tracked against clear outputs, reviewed monthly. You'll work from a shared tracker (provided) and keep it current. Core KPIs:



Links/citations earned — count, by type (editorial, guest, resource, directory, digital PR) and by client

Quality of placements — relevance + real traffic, not just DR/DA

Live link survival rate — placements that stay live and indexed

Citation tracking (AEO/GEO): a monthly prompt audit — run 20–30 buyer-intent prompts per client across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, logging whether the brand is cited, citation accuracy, and sentiment over time

Local citation health — directory listings live, NAP-consistent, duplicate-free

Toxic-link monitoring — flagged and disavowed as needed



Detailed recurring tasks, cadence, and tracking columns live in the accompanying VA task tracker.



What we're looking for



2–5 years of hands-on link building or SEO experience

A documented track record of placements you can show us (live URLs)

Working knowledge of AEO/GEO is a strong plus; if you don't have it yet, you must be able to learn it fast

Comfortable with high-volume, detail-accurate manual data entry — citation and directory work rewards consistency and care

Honest grasp of what does and doesn't work — e.g., why self-placed Wikipedia links get reverted and how legitimate, policy-compliant entity presence is actually built



Details



Full-time, with contract options available

pay range, weekly hours, and any time zone overlap you require]





How to apply

To be considered, your application must include:



Your 3–5 best link-building or digital-PR samples — live URLs, each with a one-line note on why it mattered. Samples are weighted heavily; they're how we judge fit against our quality bar.

ID Proof and IQ scores of 80% or higher on your profile

title: Inbound Sales & Client Services Coordinator (Remote | Performance-Based)
description:
WHO WE ARE

 

Clock Clean Services (CCS) is a commercial cleaning company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. We serve general contractors, property managers, and national accounts across the United States — post-construction cleans, move-in/move-out, and commercial maintenance.

 

We don't operate like most cleaning companies. We run lean, we hold high standards, and we build systems that scale. Every person on our team is here because they produce results — not because they clock hours.

 

Our standard is simple: We Finish It. If you bring that same energy to your work every day, you'll thrive here.

 

THE ROLE

 

We are looking for a Client Services Coordinator who owns the client-facing side of our business. This is not a customer support role. This is a revenue-generating, relationship-building, deal-closing position.

 

You will be the first voice clients hear. You'll answer inbound inquiries, qualify leads, issue quotes, follow up, and close booked business. You'll also manage ongoing client relationships and make sure every client feels taken care of — before, during, and after their job.

 

This role is fully remote and fully performance-based. There is no base hourly rate. Your earnings are tied directly to your output — deals closed, clients retained, and scorecard performance. High performers earn well. Low performers don't last.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

• Answer and manage all inbound client inquiries via phone and

• Issue accurate quotes and actively close booked business

• Follow up on open leads until resolved — no lead left unattended

• Maintain a 60% minimum close rate on inbound opportunities (70%+ target)

• Build and maintain client relationships — retention and repeat business is part of your scorecard

• Log all lead, quote, and deal activity in our CRM within 24 hours

• Coordinate with our operations team to ensure seamless job delivery

• Represent Clock Clean Services with professionalism, warmth, and confidence on every call

 

COMPENSATION STRUCTURE

 

This role is 100% performance-based. No hourly floor. Your pay is driven by what you produce:

 

Commission:  Earn on the gross margin of every deal you close — 10% on small deals, 7.5% on mid-size, 5% on large deals

 

Scorecard Bonus:  Hit your monthly performance targets and earn a cash bonus — up to $150/month

 

No-Refund Bonus:  $50/month in any month with zero client refunds on your jobs

 

Commission is paid within 7 days of confirmed fund collection. Bonuses paid within 7 days of month-end review.

 

If you're the kind of person who performs at a high level consistently, this structure pays you significantly more than a flat hourly rate ever would.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

Skills and experience matter — but character matters more. We are looking for someone who:

 

? Communicates in clear, professional English — spoken and written

? Has experience in sales, client services, or customer-facing roles

? Is comfortable closing deals on the phone without a script crutch

? Responds fast — our standard is within 1 hour during working hours

? Is detail-oriented and never lets things fall through the cracks

? Takes ownership — if something goes wrong on your watch, you fix it

? Is self-motivated and doesn't need to be managed to produce

? Believes that how you do anything is how you do everything

 

THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF...

 

• You need a guaranteed hourly rate to feel secure

• You're looking for a low-pressure, low-accountability role

• You disappear when things get busy or difficult

• You treat client interactions as tasks to complete rather than relationships to build

• You need to be reminded to follow up

 

HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, complete all steps below.



1. VIDEO INTRODUCTION (2–4 Minutes)



Record a Loom video answering:



• Tell us about yourself and your work experience.

• Describe a time you turned an unhappy customer into a satisfied one.

• How do you build trust with someone on a phone call?



?



2. CLIENT SERVICE EXERCISE



A customer calls and immediately asks:



“How much do you charge?”



Answer:



• What would you say first?

• What questions would you ask?

• How would you move the conversation toward booking?



?



3. DECISION QUESTIONS



Answer clearly:



1. What do you do if a customer needs an answer but you don’t know it?

2. How do you handle multiple clients needing help at the same time?

3. What is more important: answering quickly or answering accurately? Why?



?



4. ORGANIZATION EXERCISE



A Monday morning starts with:



• 5 new leads

• 3 customers needing updates

• 2 jobs needing scheduling confirmation



Explain:



• What do you handle first?

• What order do you prioritize tasks?

• How do you make sure nothing gets missed?



?



5. SUBJECT LINE



Client Services Coordinator – [Your Name]



?



FINAL NOTE



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys:



• Talking with people

• Building client relationships

• Solving problems

• Staying organized

• Turning inquiries into booked business



You will be trusted with real responsibility and expected to think independently.



We are building systems, growing quickly, and looking for someone who wants to grow with us long term.

mbers directly regarding this position will be disqualified from consideration. Please submit everything through OnlineJobs.ph only.

title: Head Of Operations
description:
Why this role exists

Right now every founder is trying to run their function AND keep the company organized. It is not working. Targets slip. Meetings happen without agendas. Decisions don't reach the people who need them. Departments build their own processes in isolation. This role exists to fix that — to put a real operating rhythm around the whole company. You will report to the CEO and have full authority to build processes, set cadence, and hold every department to its commitments. You are not here to do strategy. You are here to make strategy happen.

What you will own

Operating rhythm — across every department:

• Run the Monday business standup (30 min, all leads, action items captured).

• Run the Friday close-out (what shipped, what slipped, what's at risk).

• Run a monthly business review with the founders — pre-read pack, agenda, decisions captured, follow-ups assigned.

• Own the action item log for every meeting that matters. Chase owners. No action item dies because nobody followed up.

KPIs and dashboards:

• Co-create with the CEO a single operating dashboard covering: sales pipeline, install velocity, recurring revenue, cash position, hiring, partner health.

• Define each KPI with a clear owner, target, and refresh cadence.

• Build in ClickUp + Google Sheets, or Notion + Looker Studio, or whichever stack is fastest to deploy.

• Maintain dashboard daily. Surface red flags to the CEO within 24 hours of a metric crossing a threshold.

Process design — across every department:

• Build operating playbooks for the repeating processes that today are reinvented each time: install onboarding for a new partner, partner quarterly business review, hiring loop, sales handoff to engineering, RMA handling.

• Document each process in plain language. Make it findable, followable, and updatable.

• Roll process out one department at a time.

• Audit adherence. If a process isn't being followed, find out why and either fix the process or escalate to the CEO.

Project management:

• Translate every CEO directive into a project plan with owner, deadline, dependencies, and milestone checkpoints.

• Hold the named owner accountable. Escalate if they miss commits twice in a row.

• Maintain the master project list. The CEO must be able to see at a glance what's in flight, what's at risk, what's overdue.

OKR ownership:

• Build the quarterly OKR cycle. Each function sets OKRs aligned to company goals.

• Run quarterly OKR review with the founders. Score, learn, reset

title: Assistant Editor (Adobe Premiere Pro)
description:
Assistant Editor (Adobe Premiere Pro)



I am looking for a reliable Assistant Editor to help support my short-form content production workflow.



This is primarily an assistant editor role. I am not looking for a social media manager, content strategist, or creative director.



Most projects involve interview-based content, educational content, and talking-head videos.



The goal of this position is to help prepare projects for final editing by cleaning up interviews, organizing footage, creating rough-cut timelines, identifying strong 
nts, adding captions, and following established editing workflows.



This role requires both technical editing ability and editorial judgment. You should be comfortable making decisions about pacing, trimming content, removing mistakes, tightening responses, and helping create engaging short-form videos from raw footage.



For example:



A doctor may answer a question in 60 seconds, but the strongest version of that answer may only be 25 seconds.



A speaker may stumble over a sentence, repeat themselves, use filler words, or correct themselves midway through a thought.



Your job is to clean up those responses and create the strongest, most natural version possible while preserving the speaker's intended meaning.



Responsibilities



* Organize raw footage and project files

* Break interviews into individual clips and sequences

* Identify strong 
nts and potential hooks

* Create rough-cut timelines for short-form content

* Remove filler words, mistakes, dead air, and unnecessary content

* Tighten responses to improve pacing and retention

* Add animated captions using AutoCut

* Follow documented editing systems and workflows



Required Skills



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Experience editing short-form content

* Understanding of social media pacing and retention

* Strong organizational skills

* Ability to follow tutorials and documented workflows

* Good written English communication



AutoCut experience is preferred but not required. You should be willing to learn it quickly if selected.



Attention to detail matters in this role. To confirm you've read the posting, include the word ORANGE somewhere in your application.



Training & Workflow



I have documented workflows, editing tutorials, and established systems that will be provided.



I'm not looking for someone to reinvent the process. I'm looking for someone who can learn a workflow, execute it consistently, accept feedback, and improve over time.



As trust and proficiency grow, additional responsibilities may become available for the right person.



Paid Test Project



Qualified applicants will complete a paid test project.



The test project will involve:



* Reviewing a raw interview

* Identifying the strongest 
nts from a response

* Creating a short-form edit

* Cleaning up the speaker's delivery

* Adding captions

* Delivering organized Premiere Pro project files



Applicants selected for the test project will be compensated for their time.



To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Examples of short-form content you have edited

3. Your hourly rate

4. Your weekly availability

5. How many years you have been using Adobe Premiere Pro

6. A 3-5 minute video introduction explaining your editing experience and why you think you'd be a good fit for this role



I am looking for someone reliable, organized, communicative, and interested in building a long-term working relationship.

You’ll be part of a dedicated customer service team, working closely with other representatives and a manager to ensure that as much revenue as possible is driven and retained through customer service.



We’re not looking for someone who just “replies to emails.” We’re looking for someone who thinks and acts like an A-player: disciplined, proactive, and committed to excellence.

You communicate with empathy, and take ownership of every situation. You always look for solutions instead of excuses and understand that every interaction is a chance to create value for both the customer and the company.



You must already have experience in customer service for Shopify fashion dropshipping stores, and know how to communicate effectively, handle returns and exchanges, and solve problems efficiently, keeping customers happy while protecting company profits.

You should know how to use Shopify and ParcelPanel, maintain a professional and calm tone under pressure, and be able to work according to the New York (US) timezone, since most of our customer interactions follow that schedule.

Experience with return funnels and ChatGPT for communication improvement is a must.



You’ll handle emails, refunds, replacements, and order inquiries together with other team members, ensuring a fast, professional, and solution-oriented customer experience every day.

We value people who are organized, reliable, and detail-oriented, who identify problems before they escalate, and who constantly aim to improve how things are done.



You understand that great customer service doesn’t just solve issues. It drives revenue and keeps profits within the company.



This is a position for someone who takes pride in delivering world-class service and wants to be part of a high-performing, professional team.



Please answer these questions in your application:

1. What is your experience with customer service for Shopify fashion dropshipping stores, and for how long?

2. Have you worked for other fashion dropshipping stores before? If yes, which ones?

3. What are your main strengths, and how can you make the company better? What knowledge or ideas can you bring?

4. Are you familiar with Shopify, Zendesk, ParcelPanel, and ChatGPT?

5. Do you have experience with return funnels?

6. Do you speak and write English fluently?

7. Are you currently working for another company?

8. How many hours and days per week are you available? Are you also available during weekends?

9. Can you work according to the New York (US) timezone?

10. Do you always have a stable Wi-Fi connection?

11. What is your desired monthly compensation?

12. What’s your favorite dish?



Please include your phone number in the application so we can contact you directly through Whatsapp!

title: Meta Ads Manager / Media Buyer and Creative Strategist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Meta Ads Manager / Media Buyer to manage Meta advertising for BestPriceDTF.



This role is not only about campaign management. We need someone who understands both media buying and creative strategy. The ideal candidate should be able to manage Meta campaigns, analyze performance, understand which creatives are working or not working, and help improve our hooks, CTAs, angles, and ad concepts.



You will be responsible for both media buying and creative direction. We need someone who can look at ad performance and clearly explain why certain creatives are performing well and why others are not.



Responsibilities:



-Manage and optimize Meta Ads campaigns for BestPriceDTF

-Monitor campaign performance and make data-driven decisions

-Analyze CPR, ROAS, CPA, CTR, creative performance, and overall account health

-Identify winning and losing creatives

-Help write and improve hooks, CTAs, ad angles, and creative concepts

-Work closely with our team and communicate strategy clearly

-Join one weekly meeting with our team

Requirements:



-Minimum 2 years of experience in Meta media buying

-Must have experience managing at least one brand spending $50,000+ per month on Meta ads

-Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager

-Strong understanding of creative strategy and ad performance

-Ability to analyze which creatives are performing well or poorly

-Experience writing or improving hooks, CTAs, and ad concepts

-Good English speaking skills, comfortable speaking on microphone during meetings

-Previous e-commerce experience is strongly preferred

-Must be reliable, experienced, organized, and confident in managing performance campaigns

-Must understand creative strategy and be able to write strong hooks, body copy, CTAs, angles, and ad concepts for Meta ads



Interview Process:



The interview will be conducted on camera. We want to speak directly with candidates to understand their experience, communication skills, Meta ads knowledge, and creative strategy skills.



How to Apply:



-Please include the following in your application:

-Your Meta ads experience

title: Short-Term Rental Liaison & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
We are a growing property management and housekeeping company looking for a sharp, proactive Short-Term Rental (STR) Liaison to take over the day-to-day operations and digital presence of our rental properties in Nova Scotia, Canada.



If you love the fast-paced world of hospitality, have a flawless eye for detail, and know how to market properties to maximize bookings, this long-term position is for you. You will act as the central hub for our STR operations, taking the daily workload completely off the business owner's shoulders.



Daily Operational Responsibilities:



 - Quality Control: Review turnover cleaning reports, photos, and inspection videos submitted by field staff to ensure pristine, hotel-grade standards before guests arrive.

 

- Property Management Systems (PMS): Manage listings, calendars, and automations across Airbnb, VRBO, 
, and our property management software (Hospitable).

 - Guest & Client Relations: Act as the primary point of contact for guest inquiries, booking requests, and property owners, handling all communication smoothly and professionally.

 - Logistics & Inventory: Track stock orders, manage supply levels for properties, and troubleshoot daily scheduling hitches or maintenance alerts.



Marketing & Digital Presence Responsibilities:

 - Social Media Management: Create engaging posts, reels, and content to advertise and promote our properties across social platforms.



 -Listing Optimization: Write compelling copy, update listings, and implement marketing strategies to increase visibility and occupancy rates across all booking websites.



 -Website Management: Assist with updating and maintaining our promotional website to drive direct bookings.



Requirements:



 * Proven experience managing short-term rentals using major platforms (Airbnb, VRBO, 
) and PMS software (Hospitable or similar).



 * Background in digital marketing, social media content creation, or website promotion specifically for real estate, hospitality, or travel.



 * Incredible attention to detail—you don't miss a thing when reviewing photos or checklist reports.



 * Strong problem-solving skills; you can handle an unexpected scheduling or guest issue calmly and independently.



 * Excellent written English and a warm, hospitable communication style.



 *Work Schedule: Must work the owner's exact hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Atlantic Standard Time (AST).



To apply, please reply with the word **"ORCHESTRATOR"** at the very top of your message so I know you read the full post. Please include a brief summary of your STR platform experience, any marketing/social media work you've done for rentals, and your desired monthly salary range.

title: E-Commerce Specialist
description:
We are seeking a highly creative, strategic, and detail-oriented E-Commerce Specialist to support a growing boutique e-commerce brand.



This role focused on maximizing product visibility and driving revenue across multiple online platforms, including resale and marketplace channels.



The ideal candidate is both creative and operationally strong, capable of transforming content into engaging brand assets while also managing listings, cross-posting, and optimizing performance across platforms like Etsy, eBay, Poshmark, and more.



This position is ideal for someone who can blend aesthetics, strategy, and execution to support both brand growth and direct sales.



Key Responsibilities

1. Content Creation & Brand Development (Primary Focus)

Creative Content Production

- Transform raw product photos and videos into polished, engaging content

- Create social media posts, graphics, and promotional materials

- Write captions aligned with a bold, eclectic, elevated brand voice

- Maintain a consistent visual identity across all platforms



Brand Voice & Identity

- Help define and refine brand tone and messaging

- Ensure consistency across social media, product listings, and campaigns

- Align content with the brand’s “eclectic, sparkle, western-inspired” style



2. Social Media Management & Execution

Platform Management

- Manage and schedule content across Instagram,
, TikTok, and Pinterest

- Maintain consistent posting schedules and engagement

- Ensure all platforms are aligned with brand and campaign goals



Community Engagement

- Monitor comments and messages

- Support audience engagement and community-building efforts



3. Multi-Platform E-Commerce & Marketplace Management (Expanded Scope)

Platform Management & Listings

- Manage and maintain product listings across platforms such as:

Etsy, eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Vestiaire Collective

Gilt, Amazon, ThreadUp, and other resale/e-commerce platforms

- Create and optimize product listings (titles, descriptions, pricing, tags, images)

- Ensure consistency of product information across all platforms



Cross-Posting & Inventory Management

- Cross-post inventory across multiple platforms efficiently

- Monitor stock levels and prevent overselling

- Utilize cross-listing tools where applicable



Marketplace Optimization

- Optimize listings for visibility and conversion on each platform

- Apply platform-specific best practices (SEO, keywords, categories)

- Track and improve listing performance



4. Growth Strategy & Revenue Optimization

Sales-Focused Strategy

- Identify opportunities to increase product visibility and sales

- Recommend pricing strategies, bundling, and promotions

- Support seasonal campaigns aligned with peak sales periods (Fall/Winter)



Performance Optimization

- Continuously improve listings and content based on performance data

- Test and iterate strategies across platforms



5. Short-Form Video Content (Reels & TikTok Focus)

Video Creation & Editing

- Create and edit engaging short-form videos

- Develop trend-based and brand-aligned content

- Showcase products in a visually compelling way



6. AI Integration & Content Innovation

AI Utilization

- Use AI tools to assist with captions, product descriptions, and workflows

- Explore ways to improve efficiency in content and listing creation



7. Analytics & Performance Tracking

Reporting & Insights

- Track performance across social media and e-commerce platforms

- Analyze engagement, traffic, and sales data

- Provide actionable recommendations for improvement



Qualifications

- Proven experience in social media management and e-commerce

- Hands-on experience with multi-platform selling (Etsy, eBay, Poshmark, etc.)

- Strong understanding of product listing optimization and marketplace SEO

- Experience with cross-posting tools and inventory management systems

- Strong copywriting and visual storytelling skills

- Proficiency in tools such as Canva, CapCut, and Meta Business Suite

- Experience creating short-form video content (Reels/TikTok)

- Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Canva AI, etc.)

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills



Work Style & Personality Fit

- Creative and visually driven, but also highly detail-oriented

- Organized and process-driven (especially for inventory and listings)

- Proactive and able to take ownership of both strategy and execution

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving, growing business

- Results-driven with a focus on sales and performance



Success in This Role Looks Like

- Strong and consistent brand presence across all platforms

- Increased product visibility across multiple marketplaces

- Growth in engagement, followers, and customer interaction

- Improved listing performance and conversion rates

- Social media and e-commerce platforms are becoming key drivers of revenue



Growth Opportunity

This is a mid-level role with potential to expand into more advanced responsibilities (e.g., e-commerce operations management, team leadership, or strategy lead), depending on performance and business growth.

title: PriceLabs Revenue & Pricing Strategist
description:
We are seeking an experienced PriceLabs Revenue & Pricing Strategist to lead our dynamic pricing and revenue management efforts across a portfolio of short-term rental properties. This role is responsible for optimizing pricing performance through data-driven analysis, strategic discounting, and targeted promotional initiatives. The ideal candidate will leverage PriceLabs to maximize Revenue per Available Rental (RevPAR), increase occupancy, and maintain competitive, market-responsive pricing strategies while balancing strong Average Daily Rates (ADR) with booking volume.



Key Responsibilities

Occupancy-Based Pricing Management

Utilize PriceLabs’ Occupancy-Based Adjustments (OBA) to dynamically optimize rates based on individual listing and portfolio-wide booking pace.

Monitor occupancy trends and adjust pricing strategies to meet revenue and occupancy targets.

Fine-tune pricing rules, booking windows, and demand-based adjustments to improve overall portfolio performance.

Promotions & Discount Strategy

Identify orphan gaps, low-demand periods, and shoulder seasons across property calendars.

Develop and implement targeted pricing promotions, including:

Last-minute discounts

Orphan-day pricing strategies

Length-of-stay incentives

Seasonal and occupancy-driven promotions

Continuously evaluate promotional effectiveness and adjust strategies as needed.

Listing Performance Audits

Conduct weekly and monthly performance reviews across the portfolio.

Analyze booking trends, ADR, RevPAR, occupancy rates, and conversion metrics.

Identify underperforming listings and implement corrective actions through:

Base price adjustments

Minimum stay modifications

Premium and discount optimization

Seasonal pricing refinements

Market & Competitive Analysis

Leverage PriceLabs Neighborhood Data and Market Dashboards to track:

Competitor pricing

Market demand trends

Booking lead times

Seasonal fluctuations

Local events and demand drivers

Recommend pricing adjustments based on market intelligence and evolving conditions.

Revenue Strategy Execution

Collaborate with Marketing and Operations teams to support occupancy and revenue objectives.

Launch targeted promotional campaigns when occupancy falls below established thresholds.

Provide insights and recommendations that align pricing strategies with broader business goals.

Required Qualifications

PriceLabs Expertise

Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on experience managing pricing strategies within PriceLabs.

Strong understanding of:

Occupancy-Based Adjustments (OBA)

Custom Pricing Profiles

Minimum Stay Rules

Price Floors and Ceilings

Seasonal Pricing Settings

Dynamic Pricing Customizations

Revenue Management & Analytics

Demonstrated understanding of key short-term rental performance metrics, including:

Average Daily Rate (ADR)

Revenue per Available Rental (RevPAR)

Occupancy Rate

Booking Pace

Lead Time Analysis

Ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable pricing strategies.

Channel & PMS Experience

Experience managing dynamic pricing integrations across major booking platforms, including:

Airbnb

Vrbo



Familiarity with Property Management Systems (PMS) and channel management tools.



Strategic Problem Solving

Strong analytical and decision-making skills.

Ability to evaluate local market conditions and determine optimal pricing actions, including premium increases, discount strategies, and demand-based adjustments.

Proactive approach to identifying revenue opportunities and mitigating occupancy risks.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing multi-property or portfolio-level pricing strategies.

Knowledge of short-term rental revenue management best practices.

Advanced spreadsheet and reporting skills (Excel or Google Sheets).

Experience working remotely with cross-functional teams.



Success Metrics

Increased portfolio RevPAR and occupancy rates.

Improved booking pace and calendar utilization.



Effective reduction of orphan gaps and unbooked inventory.

Achievement of revenue targets while maintaining competitive market positioning.

Consistent optimization of ADR without sacrificing occupancy performance.

* Warehouses

* Delivery partners

* Installation teams

* Internal departments

* Prepare weekly operational reports

* Identify bottlenecks and operational risks

* Recommend process improvements

* Create and maintain SOPs

* Improve operational workflows

* Identify inefficiencies and opportunities for automation

* Help build scalable operational systems



Required Experience



Applicants must have experience in at least one of the following:



* Supply Chain Management

* Logistics Coordination

* Freight Coordination

* Operations Management

* Order Fulfilment

* Customer Experience Management

* Procurement Coordination

* Warehouse Operations



Strongly Preferred



* Furniture industry experience

* E-commerce experience

* Importing and international shipping experience

* Australian business experience

* Experience managing suppliers in multiple countries



Required Skills



* Exceptional organisational skills

* Strong written and verbal English

* Excellent follow up and problem solving abilities

* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

* High attention to detail

* Strong sense of accountability and ownership

* Ability to work independently

* Strong customer service and communication skills

* Experience handling difficult situations professionally



Software & Systems Experience



Experience with some or all of the following is preferred:



* ClickUp

* Shopify

* Google Workspace

* Gmail

* Google Sheets

* CRM Systems

* Slack

* Xero

* Freight tracking platforms

* Inventory management systems



What Success Looks Like



Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate will:



* Have complete visibility over all active orders

* Proactively communicate with customers before they ask for updates

* Maintain accurate supplier and freight tracking

* Ensure delivery scheduling runs smoothly

* Keep operational systems updated and organised

* Reduce customer escalations through proactive communication

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions

* Loves organisation and operational excellence

* Enjoys solving problems

* Follows through relentlessly

* Is calm under pressure

* Communicates proactively

description:
