Asana, Freshsales CRM and Automation

Remote contractor engagement | Open to Philippines-based applicants | Australian client



We run three connected businesses out of Australia and there are a lot of moving parts. We need one organised, switched-on person to own the systems behind all of it so nothing slips through the cracks.

If you genuinely enjoy taking a messy pile of
s, ideas, and half-finished tasks and turning it into a clean tracked project that actually gets finished, you are going to like this role.

This is a contractor engagement, not a job. You manage your own hours, equipment, invoicing, and tax. But we are looking for someone for the long run, not a one-off.

Who you would be working with

The businesses span accommodation, tourism, events, podcasting, and digital marketing:



iBooked.Online builds websites and book-direct marketing strategies for accommodation businesses.

The Accommodation Show is a weekly podcast featuring leaders from across the short-term rental and accommodation industry.

STRIVE Conference is an industry event series with speakers, sponsors, partners, and attendees, currently expanding across APAC.

On top of those there is a steady stream of client work, marketing, partnerships, and content projects.

What you would actually do

Your job is to make sure work gets tracked, people get followed up, deadlines get hit, and information lives in the right place instead of scattered across our inboxes. In practice that breaks down into a few areas.

Run our projects in Asana

Asana is where delivery happens. You would build and maintain clear projects for events, podcast production, website work, marketing, and internal jobs. That means turning conversations,
s, and meeting notes into real tasks with owners, due dates, and priorities. You would spot overdue tasks and missing assets before they become problems, keep the boards genuinely useful rather than cluttered, and send us a regular summary of what is done, what is coming up, and what is stuck.

Run our pipeline in Freshsales CRM

Freshsales is where relationships and follow-ups
 sponsors, partners, leads, speakers, suppliers. You would keep records accurate, track next actions and pipeline stages, and make sure no opportunity dies because someone forgot to follow up. We also want your help building simple CRM processes and sensible automations rather than just data entry.

Coordinate the STRIVE conferences

Events are where the most balls are in the air. You would manage speaker and sponsor deliverables, chase bios, headshots, presentation files, logos, contracted inclusions, ticket allocations, invoices, and marketing deadlines, and keep the operational checklists and timelines current.

Keep the podcast and content moving

You would manage the workflow for guests, recordings, transcripts, show notes, and promo, so every episode moves smoothly from booking to launch without us having to remember what stage it is at.

Coordinate website and marketing projects

You would track client content, images, approvals, and outstanding actions, and coordinate between clients, designers, developers, and marketing contractors so projects stay on schedule.

Improve how we work

When you spot a process we keep doing manually, we want you to say so and fix it. Templates, checklists, SOPs, and practical automations between Freshsales, Asana, and Google Workspace. You do not need to be a developer. You do need to look at a repetitive task and think "this should be automated."

The systems you would use



Asana for project and task delivery

Freshsales CRM for contacts, pipelines, and follow-ups

Automation and AI: Zapier or Make, Google Workspace, Asana rules and templates, Freshsales workflows, and AI tools like ChatGPT for summaries, drafts, and documentation

Who we are looking for

The right person:



Has real experience in project management, operations, or delivery coordination

Is strong in Asana, or a very similar project management tool

Has CRM experience, ideally Freshsales or Freshworks, but HubSpot, Pipedrive, or similar is fine

Writes excellent, professional English

Can run their own deliverables and deadlines without being chased

Goes looking for missing information, overdue tasks, and gaps instead of waiting to be told

Is comfortable following up external people directly

Understands the difference between recording a task and actually driving it to done

You do not have to be an expert in both Asana and Freshsales today. The ideal candidate is genuinely strong in one, comfortable with pipeline-style CRM work, and quick to learn the other and build sensible workflows between the two.

Bonus points for

Experience with any of these will stand out: Freshsales setup and automation, advanced Asana (rules, dashboards, reporting), Zapier or Make, event or conference coordination, sponsor and partnership management, podcast production, website agency or digital marketing project management, SOP documentation, AI-assisted workflows, and working with Australian, New Zealand, UK, or US clients.

Hours and availability

This is flexible and based on what is active. Expect roughly 15 to 20 hours per week to start, rising and falling with projects and the conference calendar.

No fixed daily hours, but you will need to attend the occasional meeting, stay responsive around deadlines, and have some practical overlap with Melbourne, Australia time. You are free to work with other clients as long as there is no conflict of interest.

Rate

Hourly contractor rate in PHP, invoiced for approved hours worked.

Indicative range: PHP 150 to PHP 175 per hour, depending on your experience, ability to own projects, CRM skills, and practical automation capability. Demonstrated Freshsales and Asana experience puts you toward the top of that range.

Confidentiality

You would handle business, sponsor, partner, and client information, content calendars, and account access. You will need to sign a contractor agreement covering confidentiality, data protection, account security, intellectual property, and conflicts of interest. Any access you are given is used only for agreed work and kept secure.





How to apply: (Read this section)



We are running an industry conference involving 25 speakers, 10 sponsors, potential partners and sales opportunities, presentation files, speaker photos and bios, sponsor logos and contracted inclusions, ticket allocations, invoices, marketing deadlines, and several external contractors.

Tell us how you would organise this using Asana and Freshsales. Cover:



What you would track in Asana

What you would track in Freshsales

How you would manage deadlines and missing information

How you would track sponsors and partner opportunities

What you would automate

What you would report to us each week



We want a practical answer from real thinking and experience, not a generic AI-written one. Applications that skip this question may not be read.





Subject line

Use this exact subject line:

Independent Contractor Application | Asana + Freshsales | [Your Name]

title: Medical Biller
description:
Part-Time Medical Biller



**Position Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented Part-Time Medical Biller to support our billing department during an EMR transition. The ideal candidate will assist with insurance follow-up, payment posting, account reconciliation, and resolving outstanding claims to help ensure the accuracy and continuity of our revenue cycle processes.



 Responsibilities



* Follow up with insurance companies regarding unpaid, denied, or underpaid claims.

* Research and resolve claim rejections and billing discrepancies.

* Post insurance payments, patient payments, adjustments, and refunds accurately.

* Reconcile patient accounts and identify outstanding balances.

* Review and work accounts receivable aging reports.

* Verify payment accuracy and contracted reimbursement rates.

* Assist with balancing accounts between legacy and new EMR systems.

* Maintain accurate billing documentation and notes.

* Communicate billing issues and trends to management.

* Support special projects related to billing operations and EMR implementation.

Qualifications



* Previous medical billing experience required.

* Knowledge of insurance claims processing, payment posting, and accounts receivable management.

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

* Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks.

* Experience with EMR systems and billing software preferred.

* Therapy billing experience (Speech, Occupational Therapy, Physical Therapy) preferred.



Schedule



* Part-time, flexible hours.

* Temporary position to support billing operations during EMR transition and implementation.



This role is ideal for an experienced biller who enjoys insurance follow-up, payment posting, account reconciliation, and helping ensure a smooth transition between billing systems.

title: Full Time Video Editor
description:
Experienced Video Editor for Fashion Textile Brand



We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Video Editor to join our fashion textile brand full-time.



This is not a basic video editing role. We are looking for someone very skilled with a strong visual eye, excellent taste, and a deep understanding of fashion, ecommerce, branding, social media, and customer psychology.



Our brand sells fashion fabrics and textiles, so the videos must feel elevated, stylish, modern, feminine, fashion-oriented, and visually strong. We need someone who can create videos that do not just look nice, but also help sell, build desire, and make people stop scrolling. Our customer is a high tier customer so we need videos that convert for this type of person.

We are looking for someone who is familiar with AI Videos. Even if he is not good at it right now, we need to know this person is willing to learn AI video generation



Main Responsibilities



You will help create video content for different platforms, including:



* Short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, and Pinterest

* Video ads for Meta, Google, and other paid platforms

* Product-focused videos for fabrics and textile collections

* Website video banners or homepage video sections

*
 campaign videos or GIF-style visuals

* Product launch videos

* Promotional videos for sales and campaigns

* Aesthetic brand videos that support our new visual direction

* Simple motion graphics, text overlays, transitions, and effects

* Editing raw product footage into polished, elevated videos

* Adding music, sound effects, captions, graphics, and visual details

* Repurposing videos into different formats and ratios for different platforms

* Organizing video files, folders, footage, and creative assets

* Supporting the marketing team with creative ideas and video concepts



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



* Has a very strong sense of style, taste, and aesthetics

* Understands fashion, beauty, ecommerce, branding, and modern visual trends

* Can make product videos feel elevated, desirable, and high-end

* Understands how short-form videos work and what makes people stop scrolling

* Understands customer psychology and how to create videos that attract attention and build desire

* Can create videos for ads, social media,
, and website use

* Has experience editing ecommerce, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or product-focused videos

* Can work with raw footage and make it look much better through editing

* Can use music, pacing, text, transitions, overlays, effects, and color in a tasteful way

* Has a strong understanding of visual rhythm, timing, and storytelling

* Can create videos that feel stylish and modern, not basic or generic

* Can follow brand direction but also bring creative ideas

* Is comfortable experimenting with different video styles

* Can create reusable video templates when needed

* Communicates clearly and can take feedback professionally

* Is organized, reliable, and detail-oriented

* Is flexible and willing to support different creative and marketing tasks when needed



Tools



You may use any tools you prefer, as long as the final result is strong.



Preferred tools may include:



* CapCut

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* Final Cut Pro

* Canva

* Photoshop

* AI video or image tools

* Other video editing or creative platforms



We do not care which tool you use. We care about the quality of the final result.



## Important



This role is for someone who can think creatively and visually, not just cut clips together. Also we are a company that requires a high amount of videos. Many of our videos will still be very simple in terms of editing because we want to keep our authenticity. But we still need to make sure whenever we need more elevated and complex videos to be able to deliver .



We do not need someone who only knows how to add basic captions or simple transitions. We need someone who understands visual storytelling, fashion aesthetics, ecommerce, customer behavior, and how to create videos that make a brand look stronger.



Our goal is to elevate the entire visual direction of the brand. We are going through a rebrand, and we need someone who can help us create better, more stylish, more polished, and more high-converting videos than what we currently have.



The right person should be able to look at fabric footage and understand how to make it feel desirable, premium, emotional, and visually interesting.



This Role May Include



Some days may be focused mostly on editing product videos. Other days may include creating ad videos, editing social media content, preparing campaign videos, testing different hooks, organizing footage, helping with creative concepts, or making simple motion graphics.



This is not a role for someone who only wants to do one narrow type of editing. We need a creative video editor who can support different parts of the marketing process.



 To Apply



Please send:



* Your portfolio or examples of your video editing work

* Examples of fashion, beauty, ecommerce, product, ad, or social media videos if you have them

* Examples of short-form videos, Reels, TikToks, or ad creatives you have edited

* A short message explaining why you think you are a good fit

* The tools you normally use for video editing

* Your experience with AI tools, motion graphics, captions, effects, or creative video editing

* Your availability and preferred schedule



This is a full-time position, with high Growth Potential if the person proves that she/he can bring value to our brand. We will start with 1000$/month but once the person shows they understand our vision, and gets used with the product we will increase.
